contract: each selected stream becomes the scope `<connector>.<stream>` with body { <stream>: [record.data in snapshot_by_stream order] }; a selected stream with no records is { <stream>: [] }

rustUnitTest.note: strava_projects_activities_and_coverage_diagnostics_as_object_scopes. Fixes the envelope only: its diagnostic has no id, which the pinned producer always sets.

snapshotOrder.note: Synthetic. Desktop's stage_succeeded_run_with_replacements appends in emit order, so a CSV not sorted by id gives a snapshot not sorted by id. Ids here are numeric strings of different lengths.
